separation_note: These are actual retained bibliography records and study groups, not search-engine hits. Supplementary discovery candidates and screening decisions are maintained separately; a search count of 58 must not be substituted for the 68 bibliography records or 66 study groups.

limitations: Tags describe the relevance of a source to the review; they do not claim that every axis was quantitatively measured.
Adjacent sources concern mechanisms, policy, governance, or HCI; their placement is the review authors' synthesis, not a claim that the source directly studies explainable mechanism design.
Evidence classified as behavioral can concern trust, preferences, reporting, or explanation use; these outcomes are not interchangeable.
Access-level labels retain source-specific limits. Full text opened does not mean a line-by-line or independent full-text review.
code_note means qualitative coding/interpretation note; this inventory does not audit software repository availability.
R01–R68 are stable coding-row identifiers, not article citation numbers, which depend on ordering.
The original AI Economist preprint is replaced by its journal version under a stable key; the unverifiable original online-mechanism citation is replaced by the verified Parkes chapter.
